sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; junior miners scrambling for capital via cap raises; Whyalla blast furnace shutdown threatens hundreds of jobs
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression; juniors (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources) show relative strength but cap-raise dilution risk is elevated

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX post-restructuring with 3,500 jobs cut; rate-rise fears pressure NIM expectations; tax burden on households constrains credit demand
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX may benefit from higher rates but face rising NPL risk if growth slows; ANZ.AX execution risk remains

sectors.trend: Oil spike pressures airlines and consumers; Santos preservation seen as a national sacrifice; fuel prices rising 30c
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from oil strength but face political overhang; Qantas (QAN.AX) and airline sector under margin stress

sectors.trend: Housing correction continues with no auction bounce; young buyers adapting to falling prices; NZ correction still running
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure; WES.AX, WOW.AX under consumer spending caution

sectors.trend: AI slowdown debate intensifies; hyper-scale data centre could draw 25% of Queensland power; ASX small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) showing momentum
sectors.implications: Local tech and data-centre plays gain strategic relevance; global AI capex debate (NVDA, AMD) creates volatility spillover

key_themes: Oil-driven inflation and recession risk dominating global and domestic sentiment
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and undermining commodity exporters' local revenue
Iron ore structural demand concerns from China pivot and Arctic shipping route shifts
Migration policy uncertainty (One Nation 750k cut proposal, visa pauses) creating labour supply risk
Housing market correction extending across Australia and NZ
AI capex debate creating tech sector volatility
Superannuation system under political and structural scrutiny

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike triggering recession fears and RBA policy dilemma
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor RBA commentary for rate path clarity; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over importers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price deterioration and China demand shift
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce concentration in pure-play iron ore (RIO.AX, FMG.AX); diversify into gold (GOLD.AX) and diversified miners (BHP.AX)
Favour export-oriented earnings; avoid AUD-sensitive importers; monitor AUD/USD for 0.60 support

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs and construction; monitor bank NPL data; favour defensive consumer staples

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Migration policy disruption to labour supply
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor agricultural and services sector earnings; One Nation 750k cut proposal could accelerate labour shortages

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike and global liquidity tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration risk; favour cash-generative large caps; watch for spillover into ASX risk appetite

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy producers amid oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil surge supports upstream earnings; Santos and Woodside benefit from higher realised prices despite political overhang

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and defensive miners as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and AUD weakness make gold a relative outperformer; GSG.AX, GOLD.AX offer diversification

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap tech and data-centre exposure
opportunities.rationale: Hyper-scale data centre demand and ASX small-cap momentum (Iondrive, Neurizon) offer growth alpha amid AI infrastructure buildout

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce pure-play iron ore and coal exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and China demand pivot create sustained downside; FMG.AX and coal names face structural headwinds

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight REITs and construction; favour consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing correction with no auction bounce signals prolonged softness; WES.AX and defensive staples offer resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure and reduce global equity beta
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; Fed hike risk adds global liquidity pressure; increase cash or short-duration bonds

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1–3 month window. Oil-driven inflation, Fed rate hike, and AUD weakness create a stagflationary backdrop. Iron ore weakness caps materials sector. Expect elevated volatility around RBA and Fed meetings. Key support for S&P/ASX 200 likely tested.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Housing correction may create entry points for quality REITs. Energy transition and data-centre buildout support structural growth in select sectors. Iron ore recovery contingent on China stimulus. Superannuation reform debate could create policy tailwinds for financials.
